title: Superhydrophobic and robust hetero-metal-polymer hybrid interphase enables deep-cycling zinc metal anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04122D, Paper
Mengyu Liu, Wentao Yuan, Xinghan Qu, Xianghao Ru, Xiaotong Li, Tingxuan Wang, Xinke Wang, Yuanyuan Wang, Yongchang Liu, Ning Zhang
In situ integration of superhydrophobic and robust hetero-metal-polymer hybrid interphases can simultaneously address the dendrite growth and water erosion issues faced by Zn metal anodes.
